text: Credits per file are an allocation: each session's credits are split equally across the files it touched. They are not a measurement of what one file cost.
Some Kiro sessions were stopped before they reported credits, so their files carry zero credits and stay on the list.
A spec's file path is read as written. A path written relative to another folder is not resolved, so it can show as promised and never built.
Some credits were spent in sessions that touched no file, so no file carries them.
